google: Terraform: the provider these resources come from
google_logging_metric: Terraform Google provider: resource type, a log-based metric
google_monitoring_alert_policy: Terraform Google provider: resource type, an alert policy
name: Terraform Google provider: the attribute stating what a metric is called once deployed
conditions: Terraform Google provider: a block declaring one condition of an alert policy
condition_threshold: Terraform Google provider: the block of a condition that compares a series to a number
filter: Terraform Google provider: the attribute stating which series a condition reads
threshold_value: Terraform Google provider: the attribute stating the number a condition compares against
INT64: Cloud Monitoring: the value type of a metric measured as a whole number
DOUBLE: Cloud Monitoring: the value type of a metric measured as a decimal
DISTRIBUTION: Cloud Monitoring: the value type of a metric whose measurements are a spread of buckets
GAUGE: Cloud Monitoring: the metric kind whose measurement is the value at a point
DELTA: Cloud Monitoring: the metric kind whose measurement covers the interval before it
CUMULATIVE: Cloud Monitoring: the metric kind whose measurement totals since the series started
ALIGN_PERCENTILE_99: Cloud Monitoring: an aligner reducing a distribution to its 99th percentile
ALIGN_PERCENTILE_95: Cloud Monitoring: an aligner reducing a distribution to its 95th percentile
ALIGN_PERCENTILE_50: Cloud Monitoring: an aligner reducing a distribution to its median
ALIGN_PERCENTILE_05: Cloud Monitoring: an aligner reducing a distribution to its 5th percentile
metric: suss: boundary kind for a named series of measurements
number: suss: a metric whose measurement is a single value
spread: suss: a metric whose measurement is a range of buckets
point: suss: a measurement that is the value at one moment
interval: suss: a measurement that covers the window before it
sinceStart: suss: a measurement that totals since the series started
